title: Meta's Surprise Water Pollution Scandal

scenes.text: A major data center contaminated local water without warning.
Meta's facility discharged bacterium into the water supply, causing health concerns.
The contamination led to the suspension of the facility's operations by local authorities.
Transparency is crucial; hidden impacts can affect us all.
